title: Known-object test, TOI-5263.01
summary: Known-object test on TOI-5263.01: positive control on the catalogued transit(s), calibrated screen for further dips, catalogue cross-match. Runner: Calibration on each light curve (sign-flip null, injection–recovery): k* 3, ≤2.5, 3; at the declared k = 5 the screen recovers ≥90% of 4-h dips only from depth none on grid, none on grid, none on grid (completeness for 2000 ppm: 0%, 0%, 0%). The null result excludes only dips deeper than that. Positive control: catalogued transit gap, not recovered, partial, recovered (26 covered epochs). Residual screen: 17 threshold entries outside the known-signal veto across 3 light curve(s), forming 7 distinct event(s), 3 persistent in SAP and PDCSAP at two or more baselines. Repeat candidate: a persistent event matching the catalogued depth at BJD 2460530.0896 (ΔT 186.99 d); 6 period aliases remain. Unverified lead until vetted. T2 follow-up is an unreviewed native-tool result; evidence level unchanged.
